name: R&R Solar Supply
old_description: Check back soon for our new website due later this year.  We're working hard to put together a resource full of useful information about the solar hot water, PV, and energy storage products we distribute, relevant to our market and you, Hawai'i's solar installers, electricians, and contractors.
about:
R&R Solar Supply operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, as a division of R&R Services, Inc. The company serves the Hawaiian islands from its facility in Honolulu. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The business distributes solar hot water systems, photovoltaic (PV) equipment, and energy storage products. It functions as a wholesale supplier rather than a manufacturer, stocking and delivering components for solar installations across the state. Details on warehouse size, inventory breadth, or annual shipment volumes are not published.

Customers include solar installers, electricians, and general contractors working in Hawaii's renewable energy sector. The company tailors its product selection and information resources to the specific permitting, climate, and utility requirements of the local market.

R&R Solar Supply is currently rebuilding its website to provide a more comprehensive product reference for trade professionals. The firm states that the new platform will offer detailed information on the solar hot water, PV, and storage products it distributes, aimed at helping Hawaiian installers and contractors specify and procure equipment efficiently.
